2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant and the informant were known to each other.
The applicant established physical relations with the informant under the pretext of marriage.

But subsequently,
he denied to marry the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant and the informant, both are major; they were in romantic relationship.
He has referred to the WhatsAap chat between the parties, which is annexed as Annexure No.2 to the anticipatory bail application.
5. State to file objections.
Having

considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
